title: Whiteboard: Task lifecycle: 14 states, 24 moves
about: One board draws the whole line, so the person reads every state and move in one place.

understood.label: You asked
understood.text: Draw the state machine on a whiteboard I can read.

sections.heading: The line, drawn
sections.body: Each shape is one state; each line is a move between two of them.

shapes.label: working
shapes.note: The worker is working on it.

shapes.label: parked
shapes.note: The worker waits for a decision.

shapes.label: blocked
shapes.note: The worker is stuck and needs help.

shapes.label: paused
shapes.note: The worker waits on purpose for something outside.

shapes.label: unknown
shapes.note: No record says what this worker does now.

shapes.label: ready-to-land
shapes.note: Finished; waits in the landing queue, #N

shapes.label: cleaned
shapes.note: On the trunk and cleaned up.

shapes.label: rework
shapes.note: The lander named a conflict, or the suite found a red the commit caused and reverted it; the worker fixes it

shapes.label: done
shapes.note: The worker finished a task that needs no landing.

shapes.label: stale
shapes.note: The work is already merged but its backlog row is still open.

shapes.label: finished-elsewhere
shapes.note: The worker finished and the work is merged, but its backlog row is still open.

shapes.label: abandoned
shapes.note: The pull request was closed without a merge; the owner decides if the work is still wanted.

arrows.label: the worker finished it
arrows.note: the worker appends needs-decision

arrows.label: block
arrows.note: the worker appends blocked

arrows.label: pause
arrows.note: the worker appends paused

arrows.label: finish
arrows.note: the worker appends done and the task is not a local-trunk lane

arrows.label: fail
arrows.note: the worker appends failed or its run fails

arrows.label: lose
arrows.note: no record names a current state

arrows.label: merge missed
arrows.note: the work merged or landed while the row stayed open

arrows.label: finish-unnoticed
arrows.note: the worker reported done and the work merged while the row stayed open

arrows.label: close
arrows.note: the pull request closed unmerged while the row stayed open

arrows.label: resume
arrows.note: the decision is answered

arrows.label: resume
arrows.note: the blocker is cleared

arrows.label: resume
arrows.note: the wait ends

arrows.label: relaunch
arrows.note: the owner starts the worker again

arrows.label: relaunch
arrows.note: the owner starts the worker again

arrows.label: close
arrows.note: the owner closes the row

arrows.label: close
arrows.note: the owner closes the row

arrows.label: close
arrows.note: the owner decides the work is not wanted

arrows.label: relaunch
arrows.note: the owner decides the work is still wanted

arrows.label: report-done
arrows.note: the worker appends done on a local-trunk lane

arrows.label: land
arrows.note: the lander rebases the one commit and lands it, one lane at a time

arrows.label: conflict
arrows.note: the lander names a conflict or a failing check; a moved trunk is no edge, the lander rebases

arrows.label: verify-red
arrows.note: the whole suite found a red this commit caused and the commit was reverted

arrows.label: clean-up
arrows.note: cleanup runs unforced

arrows.label: report-done
arrows.note: the worker fixes the refusal and appends done for the new head

steps.title: A worker starts in working
steps.text: Every task begins here. Ten moves leave this state.

steps.title: Three ways to wait, one way back
steps.text: Parked waits for a decision, blocked needs help, paused waits on purpose. Each resumes to working.

steps.title: The landing lane
steps.text: Done on a local-trunk lane means ready to land. A conflict or a red check sends the work to rework.

steps.title: Rows that stayed open
steps.text: The work merged or closed while its backlog row stayed open. The owner closes the row.

next.heading: Say go and the person reads it in Reports
lines: The board reads as a list of shapes, moves and steps until the canvas lands.
